description: Append-only. Only a human/Lead-authored pull request may add an entry here -- no autonomous engine role's allowed_paths includes this file (it is also listed in orchestration/protected_paths.json as a blanket-protected path enforced independently of any role allowlist). A decision entry references a proposal id in resource_recommendations_proposed.json. No proposal is approved, and no paid resource is enabled, until a matching decision entry with decision=APPROVED exists here.
